title: Jacquard codec linear amplicon sequencing
design_description: Library strategy: OTHER (targeted amplicon sequencing of synthetic DNA data storage oligonucleotides). A pool of 640 phosphoramidite-synthesized oligonucleotides encoding a 5-frame 32x32 CMY animation (Jacquard codec) was amplified by PCR with PrimeStar GXL polymerase for 25 cycles. Each oligo encodes pixel addresses in base transition identity and pixel colour in homopolymer run length. Sequenced on Oxford Nanopore MinION with R10.4.1 flow cell using super-accuracy (SUP) basecalling.

title: Jacquard codec R2C2 concatemeric raw reads
design_description: Library strategy: OTHER (R2C2 concatemeric sequencing of synthetic DNA data storage oligonucleotides). The Jacquard codec oligonucleotide pool (640 oligos encoding a 5-frame 32x32 CMY animation) was circularized with a 600 bp lambda DNA splint via Gibson assembly, then amplified by rolling circle amplification with phi29 polymerase to produce linear concatemers. Raw concatemeric reads (not consensus-called). Sequenced on Oxford Nanopore MinION with R10.4.1 flow cell using super-accuracy (SUP) basecalling.
